Deadzoned Morgue - install
==========================

1. Close Deadzoned.
2. Extract this zip anywhere (not into the game folder).
3. Right-click install.ps1 -> Run with PowerShell.
   (If Windows blocks it: open PowerShell in this folder and run
    powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1)
4. Play. When a run ends, its morgue file is in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Deadzoned\morgue

The installer finds the game through Steam, backs up your current data.win,
downloads UndertaleModTool 0.9.2.0 once (checksum-pinned) and patches your own
copy. It stacks with other Deadzoned mods such as the Dice Mod. No game files
ship in this zip.

Uninstall: run uninstall.ps1, or use Steam's "Verify integrity of game files"
(which removes all mods). A game update also reverts the patch; run
install.ps1 again afterwards.
